newsitem.headline: TABLE - Coca-Cola Enterprises Inc Q2 net up.

text.p: (All data above 000s except per share numbers)
NOTE: Cash operating profit $524 million vs $332 million, up 58 percent due primarily to significant impact of acquisitions completed since 1996 Q2.

1996 Q2 figures include operating results of Ouachita Coca-Cola Bottling Co from the date of acquisition on February 21, 1996, and exclude Coke West, French and Belgian, and British bottler acquisitions.
1996 Q2 adjusted EPS $0.23, including the Ouachita, Coke West, French and Belgian, and British bottler acquisitions as if the transactions were completed as of January 1, 1996.
